item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 17 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 17 FINAL #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 AM 08 September 2026

Light to Moderate rains was observed over #OccidentalMindoro for the past 3 hours. With this development, all RAINFALL WARNING in this area is now terminated.

Meanwhile, Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #Palawan(Araceli, Dumaran, Busuanga, Cuyo, Magsaysay and Agutaya) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Taytay, ElNido, Linapacan, Culion, Coron), #OccidentalMindoro(SanJose, Magsaysay, Rizal and Calintaan) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.
